3. Priya, the access-control system issue means we need to specify that only currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards get entry during extended hours -- not ordinary student-ID access as currently written.

4. Marcus, it's encouraging that the grant provides $3,200 and permits two-person coverage. Please get that award letter attached to the proposal as part of your finance review.

Given all of this, it seems like we need to revise the operating plan to: exclude Wednesdays, specify two authorized adults on site, change the access mode to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards only, and attach the grant award letter. Does anyone see any obstacles to making those amendments so we can proceed with the pre-authorization review?
